body: Water has started running out of the hall ceiling light. The light is on and flickering and the water is pooling on the floor beneath it.
There is a shallow scratch in the paint on the inside of a cupboard door. The door works normally, nothing is loose or sharp, and the mark has not changed for months.
The ground-floor flat's exterior door lock has broken. The door will not latch or lock, and anyone in the street can push it open. There is no other working lock.
A neighbour keeps parking in my allocated space. The surface, signs, gate and parking equipment are all working and undamaged. I want somebody to settle who may use the space.

Morning! Nothing dramatic - there's a tiny leak under the kitchen sink. I noticed a damp patch on the cabinet floor yesterday and put a takeaway tub under the pipe. It catches maybe a teaspoon a day. No rush at all, whenever someone is next in the area.
